name: Shebna
overview: Shebna served as a key official and scribe during King Hezekiah's reign, holding significant responsibilities within the royal household as seen in his interactions alongside Eliakim and Joah (2 Kings 18:18, 18:26, 18:37, 19:2). His role included diplomatic communication and reporting critical messages to the king. However, Isaiah 22:15-16 reveals God's rebuke of Shebna for his pride and self-exaltation, symbolized by his attempt to carve out a grand tomb for himself, highlighting the dangers of misplaced ambition even among God's servants.
